input: variants.vcf: 43 chromosome 21 records, one exemplar per consequence combination that Ensembl VEP 116.2 wrote for a pool of candidate records over the CHODL, TMPRSS15 and JAM2 transcripts and their flanks, three non-coding genes and eight intergenic positions, plus two multi-allelic records; each record's position and alleles are a release-116 cache variant's, its identifier is . and no identifier of that cache is carried
generator: scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite ma=<reference>=<candidates> --k 1 --seed 1 --multi-allelic-per-suite 2 --cache tests/golden/116/GRCh38-release116/json_cache --covers minor-allele-columns --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--check_existing --flag=--af_1kg; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --cache tests/golden/116/GRCh38-release116/json_cache --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <the release-116 GRCh38 cache's info.txt with variation_cols extended by the two columns> --cache-version 116 --variations <a directory holding the slice committed as json_cache/variations/21/all_vars.gz>; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify

pruned_cache.source: tests/golden/116/GRCh38-release116/json_cache, cut to the transcripts within 5,000 bases of a record

variation_slice.source: fabricated: no record of any Ensembl VEP cache is copied. One known variant per input record, its start, end and allele string the ones Ensembl VEP's VCF parser derives for the record, and a second known variant carrying one more alternate allele at three loci (rs9900000005, rs9900000012, rs9900000023); identifiers rs9900000001 to rs9900000046, above the range of dbSNP build 156; every frequency invented; composed for this corpus; no script in the repository regenerates it
variation_slice.columns: the 42 variation_cols of the release-116 GRCh38 cache followed by minor_allele and minor_allele_freq, the two columns Ensembl VEP's dumper wrote until release 107 (Dumper/Variation.pm, dump_obj, where they followed strand and the frequency was printed with four decimals) and no release-116 cache declares; both engines read a column by its name, so the position is immaterial; info.txt on the Ensembl VEP side and info.json here declare all 44, and both engines read the same all_vars.gz and .csi
variation_slice.frequencies: AF, AFR, AMR, EAS, EUR and SAS filled with invented per-allele values on two records of three (the --af_1kg columns); the gnomAD, clinical, pubmed and synonym columns, failed, somatic and strand are . on every record
variation_slice.perl_cache: the release-116 GRCh38 cache's chromosome 21 transcript and regulatory files and chr_synonyms.txt, its info.txt with variation_cols extended by the two columns, and this slice as 21/all_vars.gz with its .csi

divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with
